description: Unified spatial editor: a typed SelectionKind read-model over the existing (codified-non-merge) selection authorities, object-type-aware left-click operation dispatch, gimbal on path/vertex/segment selection (QA bug), and path-delete cascading to stamped glTF objects (QA bug) — plus a Cities-Skylines-map-editor-inspired terrain editor whose edits are NON-destructive PROPOSED overlays separate from true terrain, reportable on real scale/geometry (extent, area, cut/fill volume, slope, bearing)
notes:
User-directed 2026-07-18 (same message that ratified p2p D-73..D-78). Two QA bugs land first (Phase 0): FR-3 gimbal-on-path (gimbal reads only NodeManager.selected + double-gated off in Select/Pen; path vertices/segments live in PathEditorState and never populate it) and FR-4 path-delete cascade-stamp (back-ref PathAssetInstance.source_track_id ALREADY exists; DbResult::NodeDeleted just never invalidates PathAssetCache, so stamps orphan AND resurrect on petal re-entry; both invalidate() methods already exist). Then FR-1 typed SelectionKind read-model (FACADE over NodeManager.selected + PathEditorState — do NOT merge storage; split codified in code_styleguides/ui_ux.md §5) + FR-2 object-type-aware left-click op table. Then FR-5 analytics-first proposed-overlay terrain editor: terrain is load-and-display-only today (literal placeholder in tool_panel.rs:601-613); edits become PROPOSED overlays via a new MapLayer parallel to the display-overlay LayerStack, NEVER writing TerrainHeightField/tileset (NFR-1 analytics contract). FR-6 wires the tested-but-unwired ruler.rs geometry math (polygon_area_m2/world_to_real_distance/bearing_deg) into a scale/geometry report panel. CONSUMES p2p_asset_streaming's mesh budget + D-78 AppSettings; coordinates left-click dispatch with road_builder_ux and measurement scope with hexon_scale_orchestration Phase 5. Ground-truth file:line evidence captured in the 2026-07-18 exploration sweep (spec Ground-truth section).
VALIDATED 2026-07-19: in_progress — FR-1..6 (SelectionKind facade in node_manager/dispatch.rs+selection.rs, TerrainProposal/ProposalOverlay in fe-terrain/src/terrain_proposal.rs+layers/stack.rs+terrain_plugin.rs) all landed + committed at 320ebfe ("feat: height-field camera clamp + unified spatial editor FR-1..6 + P2P settings/ledger/relay"). BUT 4 in-app regressions found post-commit are fixed LOCALLY/UNCOMMITTED this session (git status: fe-ui/src/gimbal.rs, fe-ui/src/gis/mod.rs, fe-ui/src/node_manager/{dispatch,gimbal_interaction,mod,path_gimbal_drag,path_segment_interaction,viewport_pick}.rs, fe-terrain/src/iot/animation.rs, fe-terrain/src/mesh/track.rs — 296 insertions/135 deletions across 11 files, directly touching the FR-1..6 selection/gimbal/path surface). Uncommitted work does not count as done; in-app verify still user-gated. remaining: commit the regression fixes, get user in-app sign-off, then re-run this validation before archiving.
